the pathogenic variants in HNF4A are responsible for the CHI in the infants and the diabetes in the mothers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the identification of HNF4 gene variants in the two IDMs led to the revision of the diagnosis from type II diabetes mellitus to MODY, thus improving their treatment and prognosis.
the identification of pathogenic variants in HNF4A in the two mothers led to revision of the original diagnosis of diabetes in both cases.

the diagnosis of HNF4α gene variants should be considered in all IDMs with persistent hypoketotica hypoglycaemica.
the diagnosis of MODY in a diabetic mother may be missed if the genetic cause of the MODY is not determined.
